lines.text: I came in built for the battle, put the weight on my back
Every road tried to break me, I kept burning the track
Mind locked forward, got the crown in my sight
Like an alien elite touching down in the night
From a faraway planet with respect in my code
I don’t crush what I conquer, I bring light to the road
I don’t wait, I create, I don’t pray for a lane
I blaze bright through the pressure, through the fire and pain
Got a win in my walk, got a star in my stride
When the mountain gets taller, I climb the steepest side
I don’t stop for the noise, I don’t bend to the doubt
When the air starts running thin, I keep grinding it out
Every move got momentum, every breath got a plan
I keep pushing past the point where they say that I can’t
But I move with respect, never reckless or rude
Interplanetary focus with an elevated mood
Look at me now
Look at me blaze
Earth in my eyes
Stars in my veins
If I fall, I get vertical
Alien, elite, unstoppable
Win no matter what, win no matter what
I keep pushing full force when the road gets rough
Win no matter what, win no matter what
When the pressure piles high, I just double it up
Win no matter what, win no matter what
Like a respectful alien giving everything I’ve got
Win no matter what, win no matter what
I move forward, blaze forward, blaze forward through it all
I got mud on my shoes from the miles that I ran
Never waited for permission, never changed who I am
Every scar is a signal that I stayed in the fight
Like a visitor from Venus bringing fire to the night
I don’t beg for a break, I break through the gate
I don’t sit with regret, I accelerate
If the road needs patience, I endure to the end
If the road needs power, I attack it again
I’m all heart, all drive, every nerve to the test
When my body says stop, I demand something left
But an elite knows the balance, knows the limit and line
Keep the engine protected while you conquer the climb
I don’t tear people down just to rise to the top
I show honor to the planet while refusing to stop
No retreat from the mission, no surrendering ground
But I blaze with respect for every life all around
I keep moving through the smoke when the walls tumble down
With a galaxy glow and a calm cosmic crown
Every failure gets studied, every weakness gets trained
I return like a comet, more evolved through the pain
I learned from the hit
I rose from the slip
Every loss that I took
Put more stars in the ship
So I breathe, then I lock
Then I strike when it counts
When the gravity pulls
I reverse it and bounce
No resting in fear
No waiting for luck
Elite alien energy
I win no matter what
I came here in peace
But I came here to blaze
To respect every being
While I’m breaking the maze
Win no matter what, win no matter what
I keep pushing full force when the road gets rough
Win no matter what, win no matter what
When the pressure piles high, I just double it up
Win no matter what, win no matter what
Like a respectful alien giving everything I’ve got
Win no matter what, win no matter what
I move forward, blaze forward, blaze forward through it all
Blaze through the fire, blaze through the flood
Blaze through the sweat, through the scars, through the blood
Blaze like a starship when the engines erupt
Still elite, still respectful—I win no matter what
No brakes
No fear
No turning around
Star-born
Earth-bound
Still chasing the crown
I push
I rise
I honor them all
Elite alien blaze
As I answer the call
From another world
But my purpose is clear
Win with respect
And keep blazing from here
